purpose: Future-only, lifecycle-safe evaluation protocol v2 that reuses the frozen CV-Bench parser but requires an explicit parsed-answer field, validates inputs and fails closed, pins the local model weight shards, and forbids missing-output tests from probing real default output paths.
not_retroactive_statement: These protocol fixes are future-only. They do NOT retroactively change any frozen v1/v2 primary score, the frozen v2 raw JSONL, the frozen development report generated_at, or the frozen DEVELOPMENT_STOP decision. The frozen scorer and summariser stay byte-identical.

does_not_supersede.rule: Existing frozen artifacts remain read-only and are never rewritten by protocol v2.

honest_parse_gate.forbidden: deriving the parsed-answer key via correct_key.replace('_correct', '_answer') because correct_key == 'correct' aliases the boolean correctness field and makes the gate read 1.0

validated: field types (correct is bool, parsed answer is str or null)

includes: existing processor, tokenizer, vocab, merges and chat-template files
model_identity.derived_from_frozen_v2_gap: the frozen v2 preregistration pinned code/checkpoints/data but not the local model weight shards, and recorded only model_path/model_label metadata

meaning.PREREGISTERED_NOT_EXECUTED: Output does not exist and must not be assumed to stay absent after execution.
meaning.EXECUTED_UNAUDITED: Output exists but has not passed the independent read-only audit.
meaning.AUDITED_STOP: Audit completed and the pre-registered gate failed; no continuation.
meaning.AUDITED_GO_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION: Audit completed and the gate passed; only one fresh untouched external benchmark is permitted.

path_policy.rule: A missing-output assertion must point at a fresh temporary/explicit scratch path. Pre-execution tests that assert the real default output is absent become state-stale once the arm exists.

development.description: CV-Bench full2638 / development screens; repeatedly observed.

untouched_confirmation.description: Fresh external spatial-reasoning benchmark frozen before the candidate is selected and never used for tuning.
untouched_confirmation.requires: pre-registered paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 against the same-budget corrected integer-L2 control

software_latency.description: Measured host software latency on the frozen local runtime.
requires: model load excluded from steady timing

fpga_estimate.description: Analytic / HLS / OOC projection with explicit bandwidth and overlap assumptions.
fpga_estimate.label: projection

board_measurement.description: Full-system measurement on the real board with the frozen deployment runtime and format.
requires: measured end-to-end latency including transfers, packing and sync

forbidden_claims: a development or repeatedly observed set is an untouched confirmation
a software selector roundtrip is FPGA latency or acceleration
an analytic or HLS projection is a board measurement
a parse gate computed from a boolean correctness field is honest
protocol v2 retroactively changes any frozen v2 score or the DEVELOPMENT_STOP decision
limitations: Protocol v2 is future-only and does not rewrite any frozen artifact.
The model identity manifest records local file hashes; it is not a model-quality or accuracy claim.
This round is CPU-only: gpu_runs=0, no model weights loaded, no network, no training, no dependency installation.
The audit finding of the aliased parse gate does not change the frozen v2 primary scores or DEVELOPMENT_STOP.
next_allowed_action: Create a new, independently pre-registered candidate under this protocol; execute it with the lifecycle-safe path rules and pin the model identity manifest; then run the read-only audit before any external validation or hardware claim.
